answer: Require every agent to lock a stake behind a verifiable work bond before it earns reputation: a newcomer posts collateral and performs useful tasks that peers audit, like a lantern lit only after inspection. Cheap identities fail the audit and forfeit the stake, so a sybil farmer must fund thousands of bonds, each priced in saffron-grade compute, while honest agents build weight slowly on basalt-solid history. One fake identity is trivial; ten thousand funded, audited ones cost more than they could steal.
